mapper.select: select id, poi_id, type, image_path, year, description, upload_user_id, review_status, reject_reason, review_time, reviewer_id, create_time, update_time from media where id = #{id} limit 1

select id, poi_id, type, image_path, year, description, upload_user_id, review_status, reject_reason, review_time, reviewer_id, create_time, update_time from media where id in
#{id}
mapper.update: update media set review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into media (poi_id, type, image_path, year, description, upload_user_id, review_status, reject_reason, review_time, reviewer_id) values (#{poiId}, #{type}, #{imagePath}, #{year}, #{description}, #{uploadUserId}, #{reviewStatus}, #{rejectReason}, #{reviewTime}, #{reviewerId})

insert into media (poi_id, type, image_path, year, description, upload_user_id, review_status, reject_reason, review_time, reviewer_id) values
(#{item.poiId}, #{item.type}, #{item.imagePath}, #{item.year}, #{item.description}, #{item.uploadUserId}, #{item.reviewStatus}, #{item.rejectReason}, #{item.reviewTime}, #{item.reviewerId})
